items.summary: PostgreSQL 19 Released Most years PostgreSQL ships a new release in September, but this year's release came two months later thanks mainly to the flurry of issues that the PostgreSQL team needed to address as part of the ongoing AI-reported vulnerability apocalypse. This release was definitely worth the wait. My favorite new feature is this one: For applications that send reads to standbys, PostgreSQL 19 adds "read-your-writes" consistency with the new WAIT FOR LSN command. A session on a standby can use WAIT FOR LSN to wait until the standby has replayed the write-ahead log (WAL) up to a specific log sequence number (LSN) before running a query, so the application can read data it just wrote on the primary. items.title: UK can't hide that it tried ordering Apple to allow access to user data
items.summary: A tribunal has ruled in favor of Apple and against UK government's attempt to keep secret it ordering backdoor access to encrypted iPhone data. UK Parliament - image credit: Parliament Apple is the firm that refused to create a way for the FBI to gain access to users' encrypted iPhone data, so it was never likely to do it for a foreign country. Nonetheless, the UK first tried back in 2016 , and then in 2024 changed its own laws to allow it to make such demands secretly. The UK then ordered Apple to create such a backdoor and used that law to forbid the company from revealing the order. The government issued what it calls a Technical Capability Notice (TCN), which, if Apple had complied, would give it access to any or all users' encrypted data worldwide. We used it to launch two Windows games, including a 3D title whose Mac version no longer works on modern macOS releases. Both games launched with functioning graphics, audio, and controls, although one eventually froze. Getting everything running also required some troubleshooting with CrossOver and macOS permissions. NotProton brings Steam Play functionality to the native macOS Steam client, allowing Mac owners to install and launch Windows games through compatibility software.
